Changes apply only when saved. Cancel or go back to discard the draft. Queued records keep their original destination and server.
Sending and receiving can use the same email address. Settings and credentials are encrypted on this device. Connections require TLS and certificate verification.
Only sending via SMTP needs setup. The receiving email needs no POP3 / IMAP configuration here. OAuth-only services are not supported yet.
SMS permission is denied. Enable it in app settings. If no SMS permission appears, check whether your installer allows restricted SMS permissions.
Check scheduled. Pending messages send when online.

SMS reception resumes automatically after permission is granted.
Messages send automatically when online and stay queued when offline.
Tap Start to forward new SMS received from that point on.
Reading and receiving permissions are needed
Check your receiving inbox for the email at this time first. Retrying may create a duplicate.
Record preserved. It will send when forwarding resumes.

Battery optimization and background restrictions are checked automatically. On Samsung, check the Never sleeping apps list manually.\n\nAdd SMS Ferry to that list. Reopen the app after a force stop. After a reboot, forwarding resumes after the first unlock. Enable email notifications in the receiving device’s email app.
Settings → Battery → Background usage limits → Never sleeping apps
